newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia rate cuts save A$270 mln for farms.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia rate cuts save A$270 mln for farms.

text.p: Australian Primary Industries Minister John Anderson said on Wednesday that interest rate cuts this year would result in large savings for Australian farmers.

"This latest interest rate reduction -- the third this year -- means costs to our farmers will have been reduced by approximately A$270 million, if the cut is passed on in full to the rural farm and small business sector," he said in a statement. He said each downward half a percentage point move in interest rates was worth A$90 million to the farm sector.
The Reserve Bank of Australia moved to reduce rates for the third time in six months earlier on Wednesday, cutting its official cash rate by half a percentage point to 6.0 percent.
